texts.text: Type 1 Narrative and Plans — 5555 W Newport Avenue Proposed Zoning: B3-2, Community Shopping District Lot Area: 5,423.75 square feet Land Use: The Applicant is seeking a zoning change to bring the existing three-story, four-unit mixed-use building at 5555 W Newport Avenue into full compliance with the Chicago Zoning Ordinance. There is no plan to increase the building's height, footprint, or number of dwelling units. All existing improvements will remain as existing. The property is located in a Transit Served Location (TSL) located on a segment of the Central Avenue Bus Line Corridor and will continue to provide two off-street parking spaces at the rear of the lot. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance the Applicant is seeking optional Administrative Adjustments and Variations as listed below: e Areduction of the off-street parking requirement to two spaces (§17-13-1003-EE). e Areduction of the bicycle parking requirement to zero (§17-13-1003-GG). e Areduction of the rear yard open space to zero (§17-13-1003-k). e Areduction of the rear setback to 20 feet (§17-1-1101-B). e All additional zoning relief necessary and aliowed by the Chicago Zoning Ordinance to achieve the attached plans. The proposed Type 1 zoning amendment will result in the maximum bulk and density standards for the subject property described below. e Floor Area Ratio: 2.2 (Max 11,932 sf) e Density (lot area per dwelling unit): 1,355 square feet per dwelling unit (4 units) e Off-Street Parking: 2 spaces ° Setbacks o Front: Zero (No front setback is required except when the B-zoned lot abuts a R-zoned lot). o Side: Zero (No side setbacks are required except when the B- zoned lot abuts a R-zoned lot). o Rear: 20 feet (§17-1-1101-B). e Building Height: 45 feet
